description:
The fastest way to fly. Custom built for comfort and performance. Traditional and open tube frames.
Titanium Frame -- includes standard bright brushed or matte blast finish, seatpost clamp, and your choice of decal color.
Steel Frame -- includes single color powdercoat, internal framesaver, seatpost clamp, and your choice of decal color.
All Frames -- include a recommended professional fitting by Ti Cycles in our Portland shop.
^ ZWEI titanium S&S coupled travel tandem, shown with bespoke titanium tandem fork and SRAM eTAP build.
^ ZWEI titanium road/gravel tandem, shown with bespoke steel tandem fork and Shimano Di2.
